program original_flux
use module_bl_mynnedmf_common,only:cp,p608
implicit none
integer::n,i
real::hfx,qfx,rho,qv,ts,ex1,sqv,cpm,flt,flqv,fltv
read(*,*)n
do i=1,n
 read(*,*)hfx,qfx,rho,qv,ts,ex1
 sqv=qv/(1.+qv)
 cpm=cp*(1.+.84*max(sqv,1.e-8))
 flqv=qfx/rho
 flt=hfx/(rho*cpm)
 fltv=flt+flqv*p608*(ts/ex1)
 write(*,*)transfer(flt,1),transfer(flqv,1),transfer(fltv,1)
enddo
end program
